title: Page 9
content_zh:
汤绍玄不知道该怎么跟她说，原本是锦衣华服、骄傲自信的国公府世子，必须低头垮肩，易容伪装，假装怯懦，从此只能远离京城，他尝到的，并不仅仅是肉体上的痛苦而已。
「大魏朝幅员辽阔，地广物博，其实在姑母向皇上请求将妹妹的流放之地从极西贫瘠荒凉之地改为东北偏远却不失繁荣的青雪镇开始，姑母与太子表哥就开始了我们范家的复仇大计。青雪镇的矿山、码头及船队，都是祖父留给姑母的私产，姑母贵为后宫之首，做事严谨周密，前后动用的人脉都是亲信，所有的人事物都做了万全的准备，我的身分任何人来查也查不出问题，我是取代那个人，借用了他的身分，一路护送妹妹跋山涉水的来到这背山临海的城镇，依姑母的计划到采石场工作。」
汤绍玄说得轻描淡写，但她知道过程绝对是心惊胆颤，凶险非常。
他眉心笼上一层阴云，「但再怎么想保护妹妹，我跟她不可能住一起，只能找机会去看看她，得知有登徒子欺侮她，也只能在背后教训，为她出气。」他说来仍感愧疚，「我一直都不知道绣坊里有人欺负她，她也不想我出面，若是被什么人认出来，姑母为我们苦心安排的一切都成空不说，一旦我存活的消息被捅到皇帝面前，姑母跟太子的下场……」
夏羽柔在心底接话，肯定是不好的，今上多疑，连老百姓都听说过。
「皇帝对外说，姑母生病需要静养，实则是被软禁了，就连太子也被软禁在东宫，而皇帝没有废除两人的头衔跟情谊无关，纯粹是疑心病发作，他不想太早给他的宠妃及儿子们机会，他自大的认为自己还能当很久的皇帝。」
夜风拂来，桌上晃动的烛火，为垂眸的他，在后方墙面上晃出一道深邃的黑影。
汤绍玄抬眼凝视着她，严肃地说：「阿晨日后一定成材，或许再过几年，你就是状元的姊姊，而我极可能在采石场待一辈子，为太子的大业谋略，身分不得暴露……」
汤绍玄接连被妹妹还有姑母的信推了一把，今天目睹郑凯和孙氏施恩似的态度更让她下定了决心——她不应该被人这样糟蹋。
既然要坦白心意，自然该说的事就都说给她听，让她知道他的现在及未来都有一定的风险，她愿不愿意与他同舟共济？
夏羽柔眨眨眼，惊吓的是他背后有如此强大的人脉，即使他的真实身分不能对外透露，惊喜是他对她有情，这让她欢喜得要疯了。
但汤绍玄还没说完。
他将自己从进到采石场后，先从小管事做起，再到后面的副总管，这其实都是做给外面的人看的事告知她。
这座采石场明面上是采造桥铺路的石材，其实也是一座玉石矿山，他们运送石材同时掩护玉石的出货。玉石送到几处明面上的玉市，再运至各地的琢玉坊雕琢成饰品，赚来的所有银两，存入钱庄，由太子使用，用来收买人心、养私兵、买兵器，日后若是情势不好，这些都将是反制今上的筹码，也许迫不得已时会逼宫。
汤绍玄说完后，室内跌入一片静谧。
「你有什么要说的？」他该说的都告知了，就只能等待她的回应。
夏羽柔深吸口气，「一家有女百家求，我有一手好厨艺，相貌佳，本来该是万人迷的，但就是二嫁，让我的行情落了不少，不过，我也不觉得自己非嫁人不可。」
见他眉头拢起，她在心里窃笑，又一脸不在乎地说：「你知道的，我跟我弟弟过，也过得有滋有味，我的原则就是人不犯我，我不犯人，人若犯我，我必犯回……唔！」
这男人怎么就亲上了？但他吻得太温柔，她竟舍不得打断这个吻……
汤绍玄愈吻愈深，她眼神迷离，瘫软在他怀里。

他目光留恋的看着她，「如今，我冒犯了你，你要做些什么反击？」
夏羽柔瞪着他，在心底尖叫，调戏，这是妥妥的调戏，这男人占了便宜还卖乖。
汤绍玄见她白皙脸庞染上一层动人绯红，低哑道：「你若不做什么？那我继续……」
「什么？唔。」
这次，是一个火辣辣的舌吻，两人呼吸交缠，直到这吻结束，她都能感觉到彼此衣衫都挡不住的炽热体温。
他眸中的灼热教她莫名觉得口干，不自觉的要舔唇，见他目光又往下移到她的唇瓣，她手足无措，脸红红的。
他沙哑着声音说：「我会开始筹备婚事。」
她似嗔似怒的看他一眼，「我答应嫁了？流氓。」
她一双眼波光潋灩，汤绍玄心被勾动，将她拥得更紧，压抑着更进一步的沸腾欲望，「你沾染上我的气味，不嫁也得嫁。」
「汤爷这是要硬来？我可是会武功的。」
「我知道，你是文武双全，更是一个美丽剔透的琉璃人儿。」
「你在赞美我？」夏羽柔讶异得瞪大眼睛。
「是，赞美你仗义有胆识，眼界及心胸不让须眉，坚强、善良、体贴、包容、脾气好，资质聪颖，待人和善……」汤绍玄可是将夏羽晨跟吴奕说她的种种好一一道来。
她笑得眉眼弯弯，原来他的求生欲也很强，吃她豆腐还会说好话？但她爱听。
这一夜，夏羽柔回到家，躺在床榻上，看着窗外的月牙儿，甜甜的入梦。
接下来的日子，对两人来说是愉悦且幸福的。
汤绍玄为办婚事更忙了，但就算再忙，他也总会拨出时间来见夏羽柔。
吉日选在一个月后，连夏羽柔都感觉出汤某人不太满意这个日期，但面瘫弟弟很坚持，这是他花钱让人算出最好的吉日，即使对象是他最敬重的夫子，也不妥协。
汤绍玄的报复很直接，派人送了一车书籍，规定他要在什么时间看完写多少篇策论出来——要知道无涯学府的功课已经很重，再加上他出的功课，小面瘫的日子也不会太好过。
夜色深沉，夏宅，夏羽柔的屋子里。

她坐在椅上，汤绍玄的双手撑着扶手，将她圈在自己怀里，亲吻她柔软的唇。
稍后，两人甜蜜相依，汤绍玄低声抱怨，「婚期还是太晚了。」
她嘴唇微弯，「阿晨今天才说婚期太快了。」
他知道，夏羽晨希望等他当上状元夏羽柔再下嫁，还私下找他商量，他当然说不。
夏羽柔娇柔的依偎在他怀里，忽然想起阿春跳窗而入见沈阿莲的一幕，今晚，汤绍玄也做了一样的事。
对有情的未婚夫妻来说，都有一刻也舍不得分开的相思。
第十四章 两情相悦迎接新婚(2)
由于两方都无长辈，司马湘芸很大方的借出自己的爷爷，苏姑娘直接借出她的爹娘，充当女方家的长辈，何忠则很心虚的成了汤绍玄的长辈。
总之，成亲当日，两方都有青雪镇的大人物坐镇。
这一日，初雪到来，天气开始变凉，视线所及，远山屋檐街道都被白雪层层覆盖，雪花下了一阵又一阵，直到午后，出现冬阳。
汤绍玄一身新郎红袍高坐马上，带领迎亲的队伍从山中别院出发，沿途不少老百姓夹道挥手道喜，当然，也有人泪洒现场，像是镇上三朵花跟骆玉玫等人。
迎亲队伍浩浩荡荡来到夏宅。
当夏羽晨背着夏羽柔走出来时，他低声说：「姊姊，你一定要幸福。」
她心头突然一阵酸涩，「嗯，你一个人一定要顾好自己。」
content_en:
Tang Shao
"The Wei Dynasty had a vast territory and rich resources. In fact, after my aunt asked the emperor to change my sister's exile from the barren and desolate land in the far west to the remote but prosperous Qingxue Town in the northeast, my aunt and the prince's cousin started our Fan family's revenge plan. The mines, docks and fleet in Qingxue Town were all private properties left to my aunt by my grandfather. My aunt is precious As the head of the harem, I work rigorously and carefully, and all my contacts are close friends. Everything is fully prepared. No one can find out my identity. I replaced that person, borrowed his identity, and escorted my sister all the way to this town with mountains and seas, and went to work in the quarry according to my aunt's plan. "
Tang Shaoxuan said it in an understatement, but she knew that the process was absolutely frightening and extremely dangerous.
There was a dark cloud between his brows, "But no matter how much I want to protect my sister, she and I can't live together. I can only find opportunities to see her. When I learn that there is a scoundrel bullying her, I can only teach her a lesson behind her back and vent her anger." He said, still feeling guilty, "I always She never knew that someone was bullying her in the embroidery workshop, and she didn’t want me to come forward. If someone recognized me, everything my aunt had painstakingly arranged for us would be in vain. Once the news of my survival was revealed to the emperor, what would happen to my aunt and the prince..."
Xia Yurou answered in the bottom of her heart, it must be something bad. Even the common people have heard of today's suspicion.
"The emperor told the public that his aunt was ill and needed to rest, but in fact she was under house arrest. Even the prince was under house arrest in the East Palace. The fact that the emperor did not abolish the titles of the two had nothing to do with friendship. It was purely due to suspicion. He did not want to give his favorite concubine and sons a chance too early. He was arrogant and believed that he could still be emperor for a long time."
The night wind blew, and the candlelight flickering on the table cast a deep black shadow on the wall behind him as he lowered his eyes.
Tang Shao
Tang Shaoxuan was pushed by letters from her sister and aunt one after another. Seeing the benevolent attitude of Zheng Kai and Sun today made her even more determined - she should not be abused like this.
Since he wants to confess his feelings, he naturally tells her everything that needs to be said, letting her know that there are certain risks in his present and future. Is she willing to stay with him through thick and thin?
Xia Yurou blinked. She was shocked that he had such a strong connection behind him. Even though his true identity could not be revealed to the outside world, she was surprised that he had feelings for her, which made her go crazy with joy.
But Tang Shaoxuan wasn't done yet.
He told her that after he entered the quarry, he started as a small manager and then became a deputy manager. In fact, he was doing things for people outside to see.
On the surface, this quarry is used to quarry stones for building bridges and paving roads, but it is actually a jade mine. They transport stones and cover the shipment of jade. The jade was sent to several public jade markets, and then transported to jade carving workshops in various places to be carved into ornaments. All the silver earned was deposited in the bank, and was used by the prince to win people's hearts, raise private soldiers, and buy weapons. If the situation was not good in the future, these would be the bargaining chips to counter Jinshang, and he might be forced to go to the palace as a last resort.
After Tang Shaoxuan finished speaking, the room fell into silence.
"What do you have to say?" He told her everything he needed to say, and could only wait for her response.
Xia Yurou took a deep breath and said, "There are many girls in the family. I have good cooking skills and good looks. I should have been the most popular one. However, my second marriage made my fortune drop a lot. However, I don't feel that I have to marry."No. "
Seeing his brows furrowing, she snickered in her heart, and said with a nonchalant expression: "You know, I lived with my brother and had a great time. My principle is that I won't offend anyone if they don't offend me. If someone offends me, I will do it back... Well!"
Why did you kiss this man? But his kiss was so gentle that she couldn't bear to interrupt the kiss...
Tang Shaoxuan's kiss became deeper and deeper. Her eyes were blurred and she collapsed in his arms.
He looked at her with lingering eyes, "Now, I have offended you, what are you going to do to fight back?"
Xia Yurou stared at him, screaming in her heart, teasing, this was a proper teasing, this man took advantage of him and acted like a good boy.
Tang Shaoxuan saw her fair face stained with a touching blush, and said in a low voice: "If you don't do anything? Then I will continue..."
"What? Uh-huh."
This time, it was a fiery tongue kiss, their breaths intertwined, and until the kiss ended, she could feel each other's hot body heat that couldn't be blocked by their clothes.
The burning in his eyes made her feel inexplicably dry in the mouth, and she unconsciously wanted to lick her lips. Seeing his gaze moving down to her lips, she was at a loss and blushed.
"I will start planning the wedding," he said in a hoarse voice.
She looked at him with a look of annoyance, "I agreed to marry you? A gangster."
Her eyes were sparkling, and Tang Shaoxuan's heart was aroused. He hugged her tighter, suppressing the boiling desire to get further, "You are tainted with my scent, and you have to marry me even if you don't want to."
"Master Tang, are you going to do this forcefully? I know martial arts."
"I know that you are both civilized and martial, and you are also a beautiful and transparent person."
"Are you praising me?" Xia Yurou's eyes widened in surprise.
"Yes, I praise you for being righteous and courageous. Your vision and mind are as broad as men's. You are strong, kind, considerate, tolerant, good-tempered, intelligent, and kind to others..." Tang Shaoxuan listed all the good things Xia Yuchen and Wu Yi said about her.
She smiled so hard that her eyebrows curled up. It turned out that he also had a strong desire to survive. How could he still say nice things to her? But she loved to hear it.
That night, Xia Yurou returned home, lay on the bed, looked at the crescent moon outside the window, and fell into a sweet dream.
The following days were joyful and happy for the two of them.
Tang Shaoxuan was even busier for the wedding, but no matter how busy he was, he would always make time to see Xia Yurou.
The auspicious day was chosen one month later, and even Xia Yurou felt that Chutang was not satisfied with this date, but the facially paralyzed younger brother insisted. This was the best auspicious day he paid someone to calculate, and he would not compromise even if the date was his most respected wife.
Tang Shaoxuan's revenge was very direct. He sent someone to deliver a cart of books, and stipulated how many policy papers he had to read and write within a certain time. You must know that the homework at Wuya Academy was already very heavy, and with the addition of his homework, the life of Xiaofa would not be easy.
It was dark at night, in Xia Yurou's room at Xia Zhai.
She sat on the chair, Tang Shaoxuan's hands supported the armrests, held her in his arms, and kissed her soft lips.
Later, as the two of them depended on each other sweetly, Tang Shaoxuan complained in a low voice, "It's still too late for the wedding."
Her lips curved slightly, "Ah Chen just said today that the wedding date is too soon."
He knew that Xia Yuchen wanted to wait until he became the number one scholar before marrying Xia Yurou, and she even discussed it with him in private. Of course he said no.
Xia Yurou snuggled into his arms tenderly, and suddenly remembered the scene when Achun jumped out of the window to see Shen Alian. Tonight, Tang Shaoxuan also did the same thing.
For unmarried couples who are in love, they all miss each other and cannot bear to be separated for a moment.
Chapter 14: Two people happily welcome the wedding (2)
Since both parties had no elders, Sima Xiangyun generously lent her grandfather, Miss Su directly lent her parents to act as the elders of the woman's family, and He Zhong became Tang Shaoxuan's elders with a guilty conscience.
In short, on the day of the wedding, there were important figures from Qingxue Town on both sides.
On this day, the first snow arrived, and the weather began to get cooler. As far as the eye could see, the eaves of the distant mountains and the streets were covered with layers of snow.Covered, snowflakes fell one after another until the winter sun appeared in the afternoon.
Tang Shaoxuan, wearing a red groom's robe and sitting high on a horse, led the welcoming procession from the mountain courtyard. Along the way, many people lined the streets and waved and expressed congratulations. Of course, there were also people who shed tears at the scene, such as the three flowers in the town, Luo Yumei and others.
The welcoming procession arrived at Xia Zhai in great force.
When Xia Yuchen walked out with Xia Yurou on his back, he whispered: "Sister, you must be happy."
She suddenly felt sour in her heart, "Well, you must take care of yourself alone."
